drift: Batch note: in all five tickets of this round the object set carries one side and a written note the other, and every note for the second side names that side outright. Mix the forms (sets for both sides, notes for both) in later rounds.

rows.note: Both blind reads (DR-20260928-NOHELP-REVIEW-FAST) read it as pointing to neither explanation (declared A). Give it one detail that tilts it to its own side while the rival reading stays possible. Keep place, spot, lean, rival, pieces, axioms and anchor.

row.title: Returned after the alert
row.body: The receiver was in for repair during the county alert. Its battery still held charge; the owner signed for it the next morning and noted the missed shift cost lunch.
row.rival_reading: A field monitor could have been under repair during a test transmission, and a charged battery does not prove it was tuned to the right channel.
row.gloss: A repair window overlaps a public alert while the radio remains powered.

rows.note: Passed (its extra second read came from a tooling fault and also matched). Returned only because the ticket is returned whole: a flyer keeps its set share. Redeliver it unchanged.

row.title: No fault at the plot
row.body: The field trial's receiver came back marked 'no fault found,' though it stopped transmitting at the plot. The owner asked to hold the invoice until after harvest; the bench still wants payment.
row.rival_reading: A response crew might have borrowed an ordinary radio and returned it with a disputed repair bill; the note does not establish what the field trial measured.
row.gloss: A field-trial radio failure and its unpaid repair are recorded together.

cites.quote: Over 20 years experience in electronic repair and maintenance.
